title: Service upgrade jobs have repeat final-inspection risk patterns
business_problem: Final inspection failures on service upgrades create repeat truck rolls and delayed payments.
local_signal: Dallas residential service upgrade permits paired with inspection sequences and result notes.
evidence_we_expect: Higher fail rates for service panel and meter-base work, especially when the first follow-up happens within a short window.
why_generic_models_miss_it: The failure modes depend on Dallas-local inspection patterns and the company's actual correction history, not generic electrical advice.
value_if_true: A job-type-specific readiness checklist could reduce avoidable failed finals and speed cash collection.
test_plan: Run next-inspection-outcome and recommended-next-action evals on service-upgrade permits first.

title: Failed inspection notes can be normalized into a reusable correction playbook
business_problem: Correction knowledge currently lives in texts and crew memory.
local_signal: Inspector notes, field correction messages, and failed-to-passed reinspection sequences.
evidence_we_expect: A small set of repeated issue categories such as grounding, panel labeling, scope mismatch, and incomplete work.
why_generic_models_miss_it: The exact note style and correction sequence are local and company-specific, especially when notes are short or messy.
value_if_true: The business can standardize reinspection prep and shorten time to pass.
test_plan: Label a small sample of failed inspections with the schema vocabulary and score failure-reason plus next-action tasks.

title: ZIP-level housing stock patterns change the most likely correction path
business_problem: Crews lose time when older homes need corrections that were not anticipated in the estimate.
local_signal: Permit addresses, ZIP codes, and repeated failure reasons grouped by neighborhood slice.
evidence_we_expect: Certain ZIP codes show recurring panel, grounding, or service-equipment correction patterns.
why_generic_models_miss_it: Neighborhood-specific housing stock and local inspector behavior are not captured in general model knowledge.
value_if_true: Estimating, truck prep, and pre-inspection checklists can be tailored by area.
test_plan: Use pattern-extraction tasks on grouped permit and inspection slices by ZIP code and job type.
